notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyBody: Reminders, achievements and weekly summaries will show up here.

devices.label: Connected devices
devices.hint: Apple Health, Garmin, blood pressure log.

settings.title: Settings
settings.unitsNote: Changes how weights and height are shown. Your data is stored once and converted on the fly.
settings.languageNote: More languages are on the way. Anything not translated yet appears in English.
settings.remindersNote: Fewer, kinder notifications. You choose which ones you want.
settings.reminderTimeHint: When your daily workout nudge arrives on training days.
settings.pushNote: Shows system notifications while this app is open in a browser. Real push needs a server and isn't set up in this demo.
settings.dataNote: Everything is stored on this device only.
settings.removeDemoBody: Sample past workouts are deleted. Workouts you completed yourself stay.
settings.resetBody: This deletes your profile, plan, history and settings from this device. You'll start onboarding again.

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.demoNotice: Demo only. No payment is taken and nothing is billed. This screen shows how Premium would work.
subscription.freeNote: Everything you need to train safely and consistently.

adaptive.title: Rebuild my plan with the coach
adaptive.body: Re-plan upcoming weeks from your history and feedback.

insights.title: Advanced training insights
insights.body: Strength trends per exercise and muscle balance.

rebuild.title: Extended personalization
rebuild.body: Finer control as your goals and schedule change.

photos.title: Unlimited photo check-ins
photos.body: Keep every check-in in one timeline.

partners.title: Joint workouts with a partner
partners.body: Schedule sessions with a Gym Bro.

subscription.started: Demo trial started. No payment taken.
subscription.priceNote: In a real release billing would happen through the App Store or Google Play.
subscription.safetyPromise: Training and safety features never sit behind a paywall.

devices.title: Connected devices
devices.honest: Apple Health and Garmin need a native app or provider sign-in, which a web demo can't do. Linking here turns on clearly labelled Demo Mode with simulated values.
devices.noneBody: Link one to preview the live heart-rate panel you'll see during workouts.
devices.bpNote: Entered by you, kept separate from sensor data and never estimated from heart rate. Not a medical record.

nutrition.title: Nutrition and water
nutrition.disclaimer: General estimates for planning, not medical or dietitian advice.

goalTip.lose-fat: A modest deficit with plenty of protein keeps muscle while fat comes off.
goalTip.build-muscle: A small surplus and protein at every meal support muscle growth.
goalTip.get-stronger: Eat enough to fuel heavy sets and recover well.
goalTip.stay-fit: Balanced meals and steady energy beat strict rules.
goalTip.endurance: Carbs fuel long sessions. Don't skimp on them.

idea.lunch: chicken or tofu bowl with rice and vegetables
idea.snack: fruit and a handful of nuts
idea.dinner: fish or beans, potatoes and a big salad

partners.title: Gym Bro
partners.demoNote: Demo: these are sample profiles. Real matching needs accounts and a server.
partners.jointNote: You're training with {name}. It shows on this workout.
partners.lockedBody: Scheduling sessions with a partner is part of Premium.
